svg.aria-label: Network view of the webshop: Internet traffic enters through Front Door and API Management; the virtual network has delegated subnets for App Service, Container Apps and Functions, a private-endpoint subnet for nine PaaS services whose public access is disabled, a NAT gateway for outbound traffic and private DNS zones linked to the network.
